mapper.select: WITH valid_orders AS ( SELECT order_id, user_id, total_price, ordered_at FROM orders WHERE payment_status = 'PAID' AND order_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'RETURNED') ), month_orders AS ( SELECT * FROM valid_orders WHERE ordered_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) ), customer_orders AS ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM valid_orders GROUP BY user_id ) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(month_orders.total_price), 0) AS monthSales, COUNT(month_orders.order_id) AS orderCount, COALESCE(AVG(month_orders.total_price), 0)::bigint AS averageOrderValue, COALESCE( ROUND( COUNT(DISTINCT month_orders.user_id) FILTER (WHERE customer_orders.order_count >= 2) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT month_orders.user_id), 0), 1 ), 0 ) AS repeatPurchaseRate FROM month_orders LEFT JOIN customer_orders ON customer_orders.user_id = month_orders.user_id

WITH months AS ( SELECT GENERATE_SERIES( DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '5 months', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE), INTERVAL '1 month' ) AS month_start ), sales AS ( SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', ordered_at) AS month_start, SUM(total_price) AS amount FROM orders WHERE payment_status = 'PAID' AND order_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'RETURNED') AND ordered_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '5 months' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', ordered_at) ) SELECT TO_CHAR(months.month_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COALESCE(sales.amount, 0) AS amount FROM months LEFT JOIN sales ON sales.month_start = months.month_start ORDER BY months.month_start

WITH valid_purchase AS ( SELECT o.user_id, o.order_id, oi.product_id, oi.quantity FROM orders o JOIN orders_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.payment_status = 'PAID' AND o.order_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'RETURNED') ), buyer_product AS ( SELECT user_id, product_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count FROM valid_purchase GROUP BY user_id, product_id ) SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.name, SUM(vp.quantity) AS quantity, COALESCE( ROUND( COUNT(DISTINCT bp.user_id) FILTER (WHERE bp.order_count >= 2) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT bp.user_id), 0), 1 ), 0 ) AS repeatPurchaseRate FROM valid_purchase vp JOIN products p ON p.product_id = vp.product_id JOIN buyer_product bp ON bp.user_id = vp.user_id AND bp.product_id = vp.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY quantity DESC, p.product_id LIMIT 10
